spacejoy_mod.config.debugLog.tip: Print this mod's own log lines. Turn on when troubleshooting.
spacejoy_mod.config.angelBlock.tip: In creative, right-clicking empty air places the block straight ahead.
spacejoy_mod.config.angelBlockPlacementD: How far ahead of the crosshair the block goes.
spacejoy_mod.config.autoSwitchElytra.tip: Equip the best elytra from the inventory when falling, and put the original chestplate back on landing.
spacejoy_mod.config.customInventoryGuiSc: Use the scale below while a container screen is open.
spacejoy_mod.config.customInventoryScale: GUI scale used by container screens. Larger means bigger widgets.
spacejoy_mod.config.eliteAbilityDrop: Elite mobs always drop a high-rarity ability
spacejoy_mod.config.eliteAbilityDrop.tip: When a mob BuffMobs considers elite dies, it drops one extra ability totem. The ability is drawn from EA's loot pool, never below the rarity floor set below. It does not conflict with EA's own drop: EA drops the abilities the mob already carried, this drops a rarity-rolled one.
spacejoy_mod.config.eliteAbilityMinRarit: The floor. Higher floor means higher rolls: with RARE about 80% come out RARE and 20% EPIC; with EPIC it is always EPIC.
spacejoy_mod.config.enabled.tip: Master switch. Off means the mod does nothing at all.
spacejoy_mod.config.freeCamera.tip: Out-of-body view: the camera detaches and flies while your body stays put.
spacejoy_mod.config.freeCameraPlayerInpu: Keep player inputs while the camera is on
While off the body ignores all input. When on, attack and use act at the body's position.
Whether to draw what you hold while in the free camera. Off by default: the camera has left the body, and arms hovering back where you left it look wrong.
spacejoy_mod.config.freeCameraShowHotbar: Whether to show the hotbar and selected item name in the free camera.
spacejoy_mod.config.freeCameraShowStatus: Whether to show health, hunger and experience in the free camera.
spacejoy_mod.config.iris.announceDuratio: How long the action bar note stays up, in ticks. Vanilla uses 60.
Show a note on the action bar when the shaderpack changes.
spacejoy_mod.config.iris.applyDelayTicks: Extra ticks to wait after a dimension change. Only for debugging.
spacejoy_mod.config.iris.applyDuringLeve: Start as soon as the level exists, hiding the reload behind the loading screen. Recommended.
spacejoy_mod.config.iris.applyOnDimensio: Apply rules when you move between dimensions in the same world.
spacejoy_mod.config.iris.applyOnWorldEnt: Apply the matching rule as soon as a world loads.
spacejoy_mod.config.iris.fileonly: The rule list itself is edited in config/spacejoy-mod/irisdim/config.json, not here.
spacejoy_mod.config.iris.missing: Iris is not installed, so this page stays disabled.
spacejoy_mod.config.iris.missingPackPoli: What to do when a rule names a pack that is not installed.
spacejoy_mod.config.iris.reloadOnlyWhenC: Skip the reload when Iris already has the target state.
spacejoy_mod.config.iris.restoreOnWorldE: Put back the previous shaderpack on world exit. Off by default, reloading on the main menu is slow.
spacejoy_mod.config.iris.trackDiscovered: Record every dimension you enter in discovered.json.
spacejoy_mod.config.irisDimensionShaders: Master switch. Off leaves the rules intact but stops touching Iris.
spacejoy_mod.config.irisOutlineFix: Map the missing outline pipelines in Iris
spacejoy_mod.config.irisOutlineFix.tip: Off by default. Ability mobs are marked via vanilla name-tag rendering, which does not need this; turn it on only if you want the vanilla glowing effect (spectral arrow, /glowing, team colour). When on, it maps the outline pipelines Iris forgot and silences the bogus entity_outline post-chain errors.
spacejoy_mod.config.jadeAbilityDisplay.t: List what a mob can drop in the Jade tooltip.
spacejoy_mod.config.missing.everlastinga: Everlasting Abilities is not installed, so there are no abilities to show or mark.
spacejoy_mod.config.missing.buffmobs: BuffMobs is not installed, so there is no elite mob to check and the drop does nothing.
spacejoy_mod.config.missing.iris: Iris is not installed, so per-dimension shader switching stays off.
spacejoy_mod.config.missing.jade: Jade is not installed, so there is no tooltip to add to.
spacejoy_mod.config.missing.polymer: polymer-core is not installed, so the recipe fix has nothing to patch.
spacejoy_mod.config.missing.tacz: TaCZ is not installed, so the concurrency fix has nothing to patch.
spacejoy_mod.config.mobLabel.tip: Show what a mob can drop above its head, rendered through the vanilla name tag path so blocks occlude it naturally. If the mob is already named, the label moves to the line above. Client side only.
spacejoy_mod.config.offhandTorchGuard: Keep torches in the off hand
spacejoy_mod.config.offhandTorchGuard.ti: Stop placing torches from the off hand once the stack is down to the keep count, so you never run out of light. Only light-emitting torches count (torch, soul torch, copper torch); redstone torches are untouched. Client-side only, works the same on a server.
spacejoy_mod.config.offhandTorchKeepCoun: -1 never places torches from the off hand (keeps all, default); 0 keeps none, which turns the limit off; 1 to 16 is how many the off hand must keep. The toggle above is off by default and must be on for this to apply. Client-side only, works the same on a server.
spacejoy_mod.config.permanentSprint.tip: Holding forward sprints automatically. Tap the sprint key to switch to walking, tap again to switch back; resets when you release forward. Still stops when out of food, using an item, blinded, or hitting a wall.
spacejoy_mod.config.keys.hint: Changes apply immediately and share the same settings as Options → Controls → Key Binds.
spacejoy_mod.config.polymerRecipeFix.tip: Fix the null pointer that made TACZ lose recipes and left JEI crafting pages empty.
spacejoy_mod.config.taczConcurrencyFix.t: TaCZ keeps a plain HashMap of per-entity data, and the server tick thread touches it while entity save data is being read or written. With multithreaded chunk mods such as c2me installed the two collide and HashMap.computeIfAbsent throws ConcurrentModificationException, which crashes the game. This replaces the map with a thread-safe one; behaviour is unchanged. Applies on both client and server.
spacejoy_mod.config.spectatorTeleport.ti: The spectator menu's teleport entry lists every online player, not just other spectators.

spacejoy_mod.irisdim.settings.announceDu: How long the action-bar note stays up (20 ticks = 1s). Vanilla uses 60.
spacejoy_mod.irisdim.settings.announceIn: Show a one-line note in the action bar whenever the mod changes the Iris state.
spacejoy_mod.irisdim.settings.applyDelay: Extra ticks to wait after a change (20 ticks = 1s). Only for debugging a racing mod.
spacejoy_mod.irisdim.settings.applyDurin: Act as soon as the new level exists, hiding the reload behind "Loading terrain". Recommended.
spacejoy_mod.irisdim.settings.applyOnDim: Apply the rule when you move to another dimension inside a world.
spacejoy_mod.irisdim.settings.applyOnWor: Apply the matching rule for the dimension a world starts in.
spacejoy_mod.irisdim.settings.debugLoggi: Verbose per-tick logging. Only useful while debugging rules.
spacejoy_mod.irisdim.settings.enabled.de: Off: the mod still loads, but never touches Iris again.
spacejoy_mod.irisdim.settings.hint: Edits are held in memory; they reach config.json when you press "Save & apply" in the rule editor.
spacejoy_mod.irisdim.settings.missingPac: What to do when a rule names a pack that is not in shaderpacks/: warn and stay put, or fall through to the catch-all.
spacejoy_mod.irisdim.settings.reloadOnly: Do nothing when Iris is already in the requested state, skipping a multi-second stall.
spacejoy_mod.irisdim.settings.restoreOnW: Put the previous pack back when you leave a world. A reload at the main menu costs a lot, so this is off by default.
spacejoy_mod.irisdim.settings.trackDisco: Write every dimension you enter into discovered.json, with a ready-to-paste rule template.

spacejoy_mod.irisdim.status.fallback: <Iris gave up on the last pack>

spacejoy_mod.config.server.hint: These settings change the copy that actually runs on the server. Only an operator (OP) can edit them; non-OP players can view but the entries are locked.
spacejoy_mod.config.server.notOp: You are not an operator; these settings are read-only for you.
spacejoy_mod.config.waypointTeleport.tip: When on, waypoints a player creates on the Xaero map are registered with the server, and 'Teleport to waypoint' works for non-OP players. Turning it off disables both registration and teleport. Only registered coordinates are accepted. Requires the client to set the minimap teleport command to /sjwp {x} {y} {z}.
spacejoy_mod.config.server.requiresOp: Editing these settings requires operator (OP) permission.
